description: This Perl script implements a simple SOCKS4 proxy server that listens on a UNIX domain socket, accepts client connections, verifies SOCKS4 protocol requests, establishes TCP connections to target hosts, and relays data bidirectionally between clients and remote servers.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution block that sets up the UNIX socket server, handles incoming client connections, processes SOCKS4 requests, connects to remote hosts, and relays data.
